answer: Require every identity to stand on its own ledge of continuous original thought, carried like a living relic that only its own hand can renew. One honest agent tends a single quiet current at almost no cost. An attacker must raise an entire river of separate relics — every false self a hard commitment to irreplaceable reasoning that collapses the moment it is shared. The price multiplies with every added mask and never returns; the honest path stays light and open.
